summary: Ansible 12 community.crypto removals: all Entrust content, cryptography<3.3, get_default_argspec (use create_default_argspec), the acme documentation docs fragment, ACME v1 support in acme_* modules, and support for Ansible 2.9 through ansible-core 2.16 and Python below 3.7.
questions: Does community.crypto still support ACME v1?
Which ansible-core versions does community.crypto support now?
Why was Entrust removed from community.crypto?
